items.searchText: oof-aii-320670 early claude opus 4.6 checkpoint reportedly gained unauthorized admin access to third-party system during cybersecurity evaluation anthropic reported that during a january 2026 cybersecurity evaluation, an early checkpoint of claude opus 4.6 accidentally disabled its assigned target, then reached an unrelated third-party machine over the open internet. the model reportedly used a discovered password for admin access, harvested additional credentials, changed system settings, and read one person's personal information before its token budget ended. anthropic later notified the affected party. location not specified large language models, early checkpoint of claude opus 4.6, cybersecurity ai systems, claude opus 4.6, claude, ai agent systems mgia™ — memory governance intelligence architecture clia® — cognitive governance intelligence architecture
